description:
**CVRP iterated route generation and restricted set partitioning.** Use a symmetric matrix, capacity and nonnegative demands with at most 12 customers. Savings supplies an incumbent and the first pool columns.

Perturb the incumbent by sampling customers to remove. Greedy repair and relocate produce a complete solution. Add its routes to the pool and update the perturbation base only after strict improvement. Each route is stored in its actual visit order.

Solve a restricted set-partitioning problem over the resulting pool. The recombination can combine routes from different trials. Keep a cheaper recombination when available. The reference uses one final partitioning pass and claims optimality only within its pooled columns.
